notes.title: Game Update 1.12

Player Screen UI

notes.title: Game Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Identifying the Keys
I added a tip screen to every loading game. According to the last review of my game, It is hard to identify the keys in order to play with excitement and fear at the same time.

Death Animation
I fixed this bug because, on the last update, there was no animation on the screen.
